g1_1_business.what_it_does: Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd is transitioning from a traditional coal tar distillation business to a high-margin specialty chemicals and advanced materials company. The company focuses on producing specialty carbon blacks and advanced materials for lithium-ion batteries, which are in high demand due to the global shift towards electric vehicles and energy storage solutions.

items: Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) cathode active materials

customers.description: Original Equipment Manufacturers in the electric vehicle and energy storage sectors.

manufacturing.description: Manufacturing facilities for specialty carbon blacks and lithium-ion battery materials.

competitive_advantage: High barriers to entry due to complex manufacturing processes.
Exclusive licensing agreements for advanced technologies.
Geopolitical advantages in localizing supply chains.
High customer stickiness due to specialized products.

drivers.title: LFP Cathode Active Material Plant
drivers.fact: The company is executing a capital expenditure of ₹1,125 Cr for a 40,000 MTPA LFP cathode plant.
drivers.why_it_matters: This facility is expected to significantly enhance revenue and margin as it begins operations.
drivers.evidence_quote: Commercial operations are firmly targeted for Q3 FY27.

drivers.title: Specialty Carbon Black Expansion
drivers.fact: The company is expanding its specialty carbon black capacity by 70,000 MTPA.
drivers.why_it_matters: This expansion will immediately augment the earnings profile in the upcoming fiscal year.
drivers.evidence_quote: This brownfield CapEx is substantially complete, with trial runs executed and commercial production initiated in late FY26.
